description: Generic public reason-code vocabulary. This catalog is documentation for interoperable codes. The error-denial wire field reason_code remains an open string and is not a closed enum. Codes here are generic only.
notes: A denial or error is a complete contracted response.
Default discipline is fail-closed: silence is non-authorization, and ambiguity resolves to denied.
Catalog membership does not grant authority.

codes.meaning: The request is not permitted under the agreed contract scope.
The request did not conform to the agreed contract shape.
The request could not be resolved unambiguously and was denied by default.
A nonce was reused with a different integrity binding and was rejected.
An idempotency key was reused with a different integrity binding and was rejected.
